title: Latency Beaconboard: Dual-Mode Model/Route SLO Explorer
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create a consolidated dashboard (Beaconboard) that exposes p50/p95/p99 latency and error metrics split by model and by API route, with an explicit toggle and split for streaming vs non-streaming requests. Provide trace links, exemplar IDs, and component decomposition (proxy, router, runtime, model-exec, postprocess). Ensure the panels are efficient, avoid high-cardinality explosion, and support both realtime SLO monitoring and historical drift analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 latency per model and per route with streaming/non-streaming breakdowns
Heatmap or small-multiples for percentile drift across routes over the past 30/90 days
Error-rate overlay and error-classification panel (HTTP 5xx, model-timeouts, grpc errors)
Clickable exemplar/trace-id that opens the tracing UI (Honeycomb/Jaeger) with the full span breakdown
Latency decomposition waterfall for a selected percentile showing proxy->router->runtime->model-exec->postprocess
Metric queries are bounded (cardinality cap) and use rollups to avoid query timeouts
Staging dashboard deployed and validated against synthetic load, production dashboard ready behind RBAC and opt-in alerts
implementation_notes: Data sources: OTel Histogram metrics (exported to Prometheus/ClickHouse), traces to Honeycomb via OTLP with exemplars attached to histogram buckets
Add 'io_mode' tag (values: streaming, blocking) in request metadata emitted by router so pipeline can partition metrics reliably
Use pre-aggregated percentile summaries for p50/p95/p99 at 1m and 5m rollup intervals to reduce query cost
Introduce route-model composite key: route=<route_path>|model_family=<model_family>|model_version=<semver> to keep dashboards readable; provide member-wise filters
Limit top-level dashboard to top 200 route-model combos by RPS; provide an 'Explore more' drilldown that runs paginated queries
Tracing hooks: ensure exemplars include trace_id and request_shape tags; add a lightweight sampling rule for high-latency traces > p95 to increase retention
Telemetry pipeline: transform OTLP histograms into ClickHouse summaries; attach exemplar trace ids using the OTel exemplar API during aggregation
Alerting: Add composite SLO alert (p95 latency by route-model > target) and an error-rate spike alert with automated runbook link
Privacy: strip user-provided prompt text from exemplars; keep only request_id and hashed user_id where required
